items.title: After 7 months, Glasswing overwelms maintainers with underwhelming findings
items.title_zh: VulnCheck 称 Anthropic 的 Glasswing 项目七个月后成果令人失望
items.title_en: VulnCheck Calls Anthropic's Glasswing Results Underwhelming After 7 Months
items.summary: A VulnCheck blog post argues that Anthropic's Glasswing vulnerability-finding effort has produced underwhelming public results after seven months, sparking debate about whether public CVE datasets miss high-impact private-codebase findings.

items.title: Synaptics patent claims stop work on DisplayLink drivers
items.title_zh: Synaptics 以专利威胁叫停开源 DisplayLink 驱动项目
items.title_en: Synaptics Uses Patent Threats to Shut Down Open-Source DisplayLink Driver
items.summary: Synaptics is using patent claims and monetary demands to stop work on open-source DisplayLink drivers, sparking community debate about patent law, reverse engineering, and the future of DisplayLink-based docks.

items.title: AlphaProof Code
items.title_zh: DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code 智能体，形式化验证 Signal 加密代码
items.title_en: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code Agent Formally Verifies Signal's Encryption Code
items.summary: DeepMind introduces AlphaProof Code, an AI proof agent for formally verifying code, sparking discussion about its capabilities and the credibility of its reported zero-bug verification result.

items.title: Show HN: Get your coding agent off ~2019 JavaScript, onto modern web primitives
items.title_zh: Chrome 联合 Firefox、MDN、Edge 发布面向编程智能体的 200+ 现代 Web 指南
items.title_en: Chrome, Firefox, MDN and Edge ship 200+ modern web guides for coding agents
items.summary: Google Chrome, in collaboration with Firefox, MDN, and Edge, released a 1.0 collection of 200+ curated guides packaged for coding agents to steer them toward native modern web primitives instead of 2019-era JS and div-based patterns.

items.title: AMD's Zen 6 Family: Feeding the Beast
items.title_zh: AMD Zen 6 深度解析：全新 I/O 芯片、12 核 CCD 与重构的执行单元
items.title_en: AMD Zen 6 Deep Dive: New I/O Die, 12-Core CCDs, Reworked Execution Units
items.summary: A detailed analysis of AMD's Zen 6 microarchitecture, covering the redesigned I/O die and memory controller, branch prediction improvements, and rebalanced execution units, with informed community discussion on the tradeoffs.
